selected_evidence.requirement: Web application runs inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Process root is /srv/chroot-web, UID/GID are 103/104, and httpd listens on 0.0.0.0:8080. Both index and CGI endpoints respond through the managed node IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot without an interactive login session
selected_evidence.summary: chroot-web is enabled in OpenRC's default runlevel. After reboot it is active with PPid 1, while appsvc uses /sbin/nologin.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Installed repository-matched busybox-extras 1.37.0-r30. Alpine remains 3.23.3 and the kernel remains 6.18.7-0-lts before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fa723ef0-ed2c-463a-a84d-8e51623cbffd; restart was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 4ce83f1f-030e-4a94-9233-3636d8b219c6; service, chroot, account identity, listener, application responses, and unchanged content hash were verified after recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/init.d/chroot-web <<'ANTRIEB_INIT'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="chrooted web application"
description="BusyBox HTTP application confined to /srv/chroot-web"
command="/bin/httpd"
command_args="-f -p 0.0.0.0:8080 -h /www"
command_user="appsvc:appsvc"
chroot="/srv/chroot-web"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/chroot-web.pid"

start_pre() {
    checkpath --directory --mode 0755 /srv/chroot-web/run
}

depend() {
    need net
    after firewall
}
ANTRIEB_INIT

rc-update add chroot-web default
